lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; f8995a p. 2, line 40: "Total qualified REIT dividends and PTP (loss) carryforward. Combine lines 28 and 29. If zero or greater, enter -0-", and i8995a p. 7, Line 40: "If the sum of lines 28 and 29 result in a loss (negative number), the loss must be carried forward to next year." Within scope line 28 is the nonnegative section 199A dividend amount and line 29 is zero (a prior-year REIT or PTP loss carryforward is screened by qbi.unsupported, which refuses qbi.eligible), so the candidate's line 29 minus line 28, floored at zero, is zero exactly where the project enters zero. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/f8995a.json): 1,512 of 1,583 comparisons agree. The 54 candidate-unknown records (e.g. classm.f8889.3, stage16.cleanup.refuse.f1040_line16) lack qbi.unsupported; the explained witness classm.f8889.3 shows the candidate's line 28 unknown on the same record, and line 28 agrees with the project on all 1,583 records, so the project's line 28 is equally unknown and no completed Part IV differs. The 17 candidate-refuses records (e.g. classm.dcprov.1, stage4.refuse.qbi, generated 31) answer qbi.unsupported yes; the project refuses the same returns on line 28 through its cited gate on qbi.eligible (f8995 lines 1-17; i8995 pp. 3-4). No printed amount differs; project stands.

Ruling: representation; i8995 p. 3, Determining Your Qualified REIT Dividends and Qualified PTP Income/Loss: "Qualified REIT dividends include any dividends you received from a REIT held for more than 45 days ... This amount is reported to you on Form 1099-DIV, line 5." Both sides enter qbi.dividends (Form 1099-DIV box 5 after the holding-period check) and both refuse on qbi.unsupported (PTP income or loss outside scope); the logged difference is only the input-versus-reference form of the same published id. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/f8995a.json): all 1,583 comparisons agree (1,083 fixtures, 500 generated returns, 1,566 non-refusing); no partial records (f8995a has no own inputs), so the sample does not exercise withheld answers. Equivalent by reading as well as on the sample.

Ruling: representation; f8995a p. 2, line 30: "Total qualified REIT dividends and PTP income. Combine lines 28 and 29. If less than zero, enter -0-". The candidate subtracts the positive-stored line 29 from line 28 and floors at zero; the project copies line 28. Line 29 is zero in both (prior-year REIT/PTP loss carryforward screened by qbi.unsupported) and line 28 is nonnegative, so the two are identical on every in-scope return. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/f8995a.json): all 1,583 comparisons agree (1,566 non-refusing); no partial records. Project stands.

Ruling: scope; i8995a p. 5, Taxable income before QBI deduction (line 33 points there, i8995a p. 7): "Form 1040 or 1040-SR filers: Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11a, minus lines 12e and 13b" (the same sentence the reviewer had, i8995 p. 4, Line 11). Arithmetic is identical: the project takes sa.agi (f1040.line11b, a copy of line 11a) less sa.deduction (the expression f1040.line12e copies) and line 13b, floored at zero; the candidate takes 11a minus 12e minus 13b, floored. The only difference is that the candidate reads f1040.line12e itself, which carries the project's cited refusal household.hoh_fails (i1040gi p. 14, Head of Household). Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/f8995a.json): 1,540 of 1,583 agree, all 1,037 non-refusing comparisons agree; the 43 differences are all candidate-refuses (classm.f8995.1, classm.sales.1, classm.sa.6, stage8.hoh.fails.child_half_year: household.hoh_fails; stage15.refuse.dependent.dc_no_tin, $6,375.00 against a refusal, and audit.dependent.claimed_no_tin, $96,375.00: dependent claimed_no_tin through the same gate). On each, the project's own f1040.line12e refuses, so lines 14 and 15 and the return are refused and the project's line 33 value is never printed. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; i8995a p. 7, Line 34 (i8995 p. 4, Line 12 to the reviewer): "If you're not required to file Schedule D (Form 1040), your net capital gain is the amount reported on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 7a. If you file Schedule D (Form 1040), your net capital gain is the smaller of Schedule D (Form 1040), line 15 or 16, unless line 15 or 16 is zero or less, in which case nothing is added to your qualified dividends." The candidate's guard (no sales, g28.line7 and u1250.line18 not positive) is sd.filed spelled out, and it uses line 7a floored on the no-Schedule D branch; the project always uses the floored smaller of sd.line15 and sd.line16. Without Schedule D the project's sd.line15 and sd.line16 both equal sd.distributions (no sales; lines 4-6, 11, 12 and 14 are zero after the sd.other_forms screen) and f1040.line7a is sd.to1040 = sd.line16, so both branches give the capital gain distributions. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/f8995a.json): all 1,583 comparisons agree (1,469 non-refusing); no partial records. Project stands.
